QuestInfo.name: Cannon Trooper
QuestInfo.0: Ask Pedro about becoming a Cannon Trooper.
QuestInfo.1: To become an Cannon Trooper, you must touch the Holy Stone at the Holy Ground in the Snowfield. You can get there from #rSharp Cliff I#k.\n\n#i4031059##t4031059# #b#c4031059# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You have become a Cannon Trooper!

0.0: You want to prove you're ready, then take my test. All you got to do is go where I say, beat the enemy there, and bring me the spoils of your battle. If you're a real Pirate, it should be a piece of cake... Heh.
0.1: Go to Sharp Cliff I and find the Holy Ground at the Snowfield. You'll see a Holy Stone there. Touch it, and you'll find your target. Show no mercy!
0.2: All right, then! Show me what you're made of!\r\n#b(You will be moved to the Holy Ground at the Snowfield if you accept.)#k

no.0: Giving up? I knew you were just another landlubber!
